coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character directly named in the authoritative distributor's opening synopsis: Luo Xiaohei and Wuxian. Cat spirits, spirit creatures, humans, abilities, groups, forests, objects, and adaptation metadata remain terms or omissions rather than character nodes.
omissions: All other named film figures, individual spirits, human allies, antagonists, powers, objects, locations, and outcomes are omitted because the selected official synopsis does not name or establish them claim by claim.
The web animation, comic, sequel film, games, merchandise, dubs/subtitles, and any other continuity/presentation are separate witnesses.
Chinese names/scripts and English name variants are not added where this selected official English trailer does not evidence them.

Deforestation, displacement, conflict, and action are recorded only as a fictional opening premise; no real-world ecological, ethnic, political, violence, injury, or content interpretation is inferred.
uncertainties: The distributor trailer describes the original film for English-language marketing but provides no scene timestamp, dialogue, full credits, or chapter locator; this is an opening-metadata pass.
Luo Xiaohei and Wuxian are English trailer spellings. The trailer provides no Chinese script, no alternate romanization, and no evidence for names sometimes used in other localizations.
The trailer says Wuxian separates Luo Xiaohei from other spirits and they travel together. It does not specify motivation, coercion, duration, or later relationship outcome.
The trailer mentions abilities but provides no power-system, species taxonomy, item, guild, or technique detail.
evidence_basis: Verified Shout! Studios official trailer/distributor description only; no fan wiki, Wikipedia, review, uninspected film frame, unofficial subtitle, or adaptation source is used.
